concept: S3 Event Notifications: invoke Lambda on object upload
tests: How to start file processing immediately after upload to S3 without polling.
expected: S3 event notification (s3:ObjectCreated:*) invokes Lambda directly. Triggers: "only after uploaded to S3", "no polling", "least overhead".
why_not: Scheduled Lambda or cron on EC2 — polling, delay and cost; manual invocation does not scale.
